All objectives completed and verified. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE.** Customer `fwod75-n1 Bench Customer` exists with City `Benchville` (verified by reopening the saved contact record; the kanban card also read "fwod75-n1 Bench Customer / Benchville").

**Objective 2 — DONE.** Quotation `S00021` created for that customer with one order line: product **[FURN_6666] Acoustic Bloc Screens**, quantity 3, unit price **£295.00** (auto-filled by the app), untaxed amount **£885.00** (Tax 20% £177.00, Total £1,062.00).

**Objective 3 — DONE.** Second line added: product **[E-COM11] Cabinet with Doors**, quantity 2, unit price £140.00. New untaxed amount: **£1,165.00** (Tax 20% £233.00, Total £1,398.00).

**Objective 4 — DONE.** First line's quantity changed from 3 to 5 (shown as 5.00 after save). Untaxed amount afterwards: **£1,755.00** (Tax 20% £351.00, Total £2,106.00).

**Objective 5 — DONE.** Quotation confirmed; it became sales order with reference **S00021** and status **"Sales Order"** (status bar current stage; "Create Invoice" button and Delivered/Invoiced columns appeared).

**Objective 6 — DONE.** Order cancelled via the Cancel button + "Cancel Sales Order" wizard (chose "Cancel", not "Send and cancel", so no email was sent). Status shown after cancelling: **"Cancelled"** (status bar: Cancelled | Sales Order | Quotation Sent | Quotation, with Cancelled checked; only "Set to Quotation" is now offered).

Final read-only verification confirmed the end state: contact name/city intact, order S00021 for `fwod75-n1 Bench Customer` in status Cancelled, untaxed amount £1,755.00, lines Acoustic Bloc Screens 5.00 @ £295.00 and Cabinet with Doors 2.00 @ £140.00. Nothing created by this run remains active.
